stations.title: Imogen
stations.say: Why does the sheet print nonsense?

stations.title: Node
stations.text: Runs the code and never looks at the types.

stations.title: Packing table
stations.text: Bryn packs order OK-1042 from the sheet.

captions: Oakhollow Tea Company. Imogen asks why the order sheet still prints nonsense.
Node runs the sheet without a look at the types, so order OK-1042 comes out wrong.
You read what the compiler says about four lines, and fix each line.
Now the compiler is quiet, and order OK-1042 reaches the packing table right.
The types were promises all along, and now the code keeps them.
